meta.name: qodo-pr-resolver
meta.description: Review and resolve PR issues with Qodo - get AI-powered code review issues and fix them interactively (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps)

copy.tagline: 审查并交互式修复代码审查问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查PR并修复代码问题
copy.tagline_en: Review and fix code review issues interactively
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often review PRs and fix code issues

howto.what: 装上后，当你发起代码审查或修复请求时，Claude 会自动获取当前 Git 分支 PR 中 Qodo AI 给出的审查意见（包括 Bug、安全、代码质量等），以表格展示，并根据你的选择逐个或批量修复问题，每次修复后自动 Git 提交并回复 Qodo 的评论。
howto.when: 当你在支持的 Git 仓库（GitHub、GitLab、Bitbucket、Azure DevOps）中，当前分支有已开启的 PR 且已被 Qodo 审查，并且你提出查看、获取或修复 Qodo 审查意见时触发。

say.text: 查看当前分支的 Qodo 审查意见。
say.note: 将展示所有问题的表格。

say.text: 自动修复所有 Qodo 发现的问题。
say.note: Claude 将批量应用修复并提交。

say.text: 逐个审查并修复 Qodo issue。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude fetches Qodo AI review issues for the current branch's PR, displays them as a table, then lets you choose to fix them one by one or auto-fix all. It applies fixes, commits, and replies to each inline comment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request to view, fetch, or fix Qodo review issues in a supported git repository (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps) with an open PR that has been reviewed by Qodo.

say_en.text: Show Qodo review issues for the current branch.
say_en.note: Displays a table of all issues.
Claude applies fixes and commits them.

say_en.text: Review each Qodo issue and fix interactively.
say_en.note: Claude asks for approval per issue.
